key.name: position
key.summary: Screen edge the dock floats along

key.name: behavior
key.summary: When the dock is visible
key.description: always (the default, as on Windows 11): visible and reserves space, so maximized and snapped windows fit above it; intellihide: hides only when a window overlaps it; autohide: appears when the pointer reaches the screen edge. In the modules style a hidden taskbar comes back one module at a time: only the module above the pointer.

key.name: icon-size
key.summary: Preferred icon size in pixels; shrinks automatically when apps do not fit

key.name: show-running
key.summary: Show running applications that are not favorites

key.name: show-apps-button
key.summary: Show an applications button at the end of the dock (the Start button already opens the launcher)

key.name: show-start-button
key.summary: Show the JERONIX Start button (opens the Start menu) at the head of the dock

key.name: show-search-button
key.summary: Show the Search button (GNOME search: applications, files, settings)

key.name: style
key.summary: Expandable modules, a full-width Windows 11-style taskbar, or a floating dock (side positions are always floating)
key.description: modules: three floating modules (live updates and widgets, Start and apps, Control Center and notifications), each expanding into the panel it opens.

key.name: alignment
key.summary: Where the apps sit on the taskbar

key.name: system-tray
key.summary: Show Quick Settings and the clock with notifications in the bar (bottom only)

key.name: hide-top-bar
key.summary: Hide GNOME's top bar while the bar carries the system tray

key.name: show-task-view-button
key.summary: Show the Task View button (windows and workspaces overview)

key.name: start-menu-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that opens the Start menu

key.name: super-key-start-menu
key.summary: The Super key opens the Start menu instead of the overview

key.name: start-pinned-apps
key.summary: Apps pinned to the Start menu, in order
key.description: Desktop IDs. Separate from the taskbar's pins (GNOME's favorite-apps). Apps that are not installed are skipped and keep their place.

key.name: start-hidden-apps
key.summary: Apps the Start menu never lists or finds
key.description: Desktop IDs. By default GNOME Settings, which JERONIX Settings replaces, and Help, which shows Ubuntu's desktop guide.

key.name: control-center-modules
key.summary: Control Center modules, in order
key.description: Modules not listed are hidden. Modules whose hardware or service is missing are left out automatically. Ids: wifi, bluetooth, airplane-mode, vpn, focus, stay-awake, dark-mode, night-light, power-mode, display, sound, now-playing, battery, screenshot, screen-recording, settings.

key.name: control-center-reduce-transparency
key.summary: Draw the Control Center on a solid background

key.name: hide-overview-dash
key.summary: Hide GNOME's dash and app grid button in the overview (Task View)

key.name: magnify
key.summary: Magnify icons under the pointer

key.name: show-previews
key.summary: Show window previews when hovering a running application

key.name: live-updates
key.summary: Show live updates and the widgets button in the taskbar
key.description: The free left end of the taskbar shows what is going on (music, a screen recording, volume, notifications, charging) and opens the widgets.

key.name: live-widgets
key.summary: Widgets, in order
key.description: Known widgets: clock, timer, media, weather, system, battery. A widget without its hardware or app (battery, weather) is left out by itself.

key.name: live-activities
key.summary: What the live updates show
key.description: Known: media, timers, recording, privacy (microphone and camera in use), downloads, levels (volume, brightness and microphone mute), notifications, battery, network, keyboard (Caps Lock and keyboard layout), stay-awake, do-not-disturb, workspaces (the workspace switched to).

key.name: live-colors
key.summary: Colors of the live updates
key.description: dynamic: the color of what is going on (red while recording, orange for a timer, the album's color for music); accent: the system accent color; neutral: no color.

key.name: live-expand
key.summary: Expand the live updates on hover
key.description: Hovering the live updates grows them with more controls (next track, a minute more on a timer, quick actions), like the Dynamic Island.
